facts.business: SMC Global Securities Limited is a financial services company providing equity and commodity brokerage, insurance distribution, investment advisory, margin trading funding, and related services through its subsidiaries.
facts.related_party_note: During the year, the Company has provided loans to subsidiaries: aggregate amount granted/provided during the year Rs 4,770.66 lakhs; balance outstanding as at Balance Sheet date Rs 1,893.09 lakhs. The Company has not provided advances in nature of loans or loans other than Margin Trading Funding (MTF), stood guarantee or provided security to companies, firms, LLPs or any other parties.
